title: pending_seek is a one-shot slot cleared only by playing the matching clip or closing the viewer; reset_viewer_item_state (step) leaves it
trigger: open a media-timestamp link or change quality with autoplay off, step to another item and back
effect: the clip later starts from the old second instead of 0
fix: carry the start in the ViewerClip stage (Opening { item, start }) so a step drops it

title: Viewer pointer state drag (pan anchor) and over_controls bool are reset by hand at several sites (navigation.rs:207,276; playback.rs:628,635; overlay.rs:389; close only for over_controls)
trigger: pan a zoomed photo then step, or rest the pointer on a control and step/close via key
effect: over_controls stays true after a step until the next mouse move, so auto-hide is held
fix: one Pointer enum on ViewerUi replaced whole in reset_viewer_item_state

title: orientation and Reorient are two copies of the photo turn: orientation commits when the decode lands while Reorient::Decoding.target and the shown code are compared by hand (overlay.rs:188)
trigger: press Rotate twice quickly, or rotate a photo that is not downloaded
effect: none today
fix: Reorient owns the requested and the shown orientation

title: ROTATIONS thread-local RefCell uses borrow()/borrow_mut() (lines 104, 136) in non-test code
trigger: Re-entrant call into with_stored_rotation/rotate while a guard is held (none today; short guards)
effect: Panic if ever nested
fix: Use try_borrow/try_borrow_mut with early return, or a Cell-free map owned by the app

title: baseline: Lookup::pending (ask-for-another-frame flag set together with fade_started/made)
trigger: canvas lookup returns pending=true when a newer image is on its way or a picture was just made; the caller requests an animation frame
effect: no bug today; pending is derived from made||fade_started and nothing names the stage (Settled / Rendering / JustMade / Fading)
fix: enum LookStage { Settled, Rendering, JustMade, FadeStarted } on Lookup, with pending() derived

title: baseline: Lookup::fade_started (second bool that implies pending)
trigger: settle() starts a crossfade; fade_started and pending are both set by hand in ready()
effect: no bug today; two bools that must change together (fade_started implies pending)
fix: fold into the same LookStage enum as C3-001

title: FADES is keyed by wallpaper identity only, so two windows showing the same wallpaper share one crossfade picture
trigger: main window and a chat window show the same wallpaper; its rotation changes; each window's settle() inserts a Fade from its own window-sized picture, last writer wins
effect: one window may fade out a picture made for the other window's size (stretched) for 200 ms
fix: key FADES by (window, identity) or by slot

title: PreviewStage::Looking{request} never compares its request; the answer is read from the session's BackgroundSearch state
trigger: Open a bg/ link preview
effect: drain_background_lookup moves Looking to Editing/Failed on Found/Idle whatever request produced it; the held RequestId is unused (the match is in apply.rs by Waiting(extra))
fix: Take the answer by the stage's RequestId from background_answers like Sharing does

title: Share is clickable while Sharing and the Blur box does not leave Sharing
trigger: Press Share, then press Share again or toggle Blur before the link answers
effect: A second click overwrites Sharing{request} (the first answer is dropped, one wasted getBackgroundUrl); a Blur change during Sharing copies the link for the old blur type while the box shows the new choice
fix: Disable Share in Sharing and reset Sharing to Editing (dropping its request) on a Blur change

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog body closure
trigger: The dialog content closure runs again or re-entrantly while a borrow is held
effect: borrow_mut can panic on a re-entrant call; a second call also renders an empty body (take())
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure or use a Cell-free take at build time

title: Rendered::complete bool marks a fill shown without its pattern so the cache retries later
trigger: Pattern file unreadable
effect: Fixed in last pass with retry_at, but the stage is still a bool
fix: enum Rendered { Whole(..), FillOnly(..) }

title: Notes::Loaded is never refetched
trigger: Open What's New, leave Quill running, a newer release is published and the update banner opens What's New
effect: The window lists the notes from the first open, without the newer release, until restart; only Idle and Failed load again. open_whats_new reloads only on Notes::Idle | Notes::Failed
fix: Loaded carries a fetched-at time (manual clock) or reload when opened after an update check finds a newer version

title: Pointer is three fields (hold, pressed, hovered) reset together by hand
trigger: Press, hover and long-press on a widget; widgets_state::Pointer::release clears all three.
effect: None today (released when the widget leaves the screen or its runtime stops).
fix: enum Pointer { Away, Over, Pressed{button, hold} }

title: Pointer is hold bool + pressed Option + hovered bool, three fields reset together by release()
trigger: press and hold on a widget, then it goes off screen
effect: none today (release_pointer covers it)
fix: enum Pointer { Away, Hover, Pressed { button, hold } }

title: WidgetsUi::lander Option<Task> is a started flag: watch_widget_runtimes returns when is_some, nothing restarts it if its loop ended
trigger: the lander loop breaks when the app entity update fails
effect: widgets stop landing frames for the rest of the screen
fix: enum Lander { NotStarted, Running(Task) } with the loop's end setting a state the starter reacts to

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut on WidgetsUi::passes at 5 sites (72, 82, 93, 186, 211); begin_widget_pass holds the guard across defer_screen
trigger: a render pass (begin_widget_pass/note_widget, run during render with &self) re-entered while a guard from reconcile_widgets/widgets_left_window is live, e.g. a nested window render
effect: BorrowMutError panic = app crash
fix: plain fields mutated through &mut self (pass queue per WindowSlot) or a Cell-based API with no guard held across calls

title: RuntimeEvent::Request sends getWidgetQuery to TDLib even when the entry has no live runtime (live_mut() is None), so nothing records the token
trigger: one land_widgets batch holds Stopped/Failed then a Request from the same runtime
effect: wasted TDLib call whose answer is dropped by answer_widget_query
fix: send only when live.queries.insert succeeded; otherwise fail the request locally

title: title_badge.borrow_mut() guard lives to the end of the statement, across other_accounts_unread()
trigger: window_title_in_place every frame
effect: The guard is held over a call into another module (panic-safety rule 6); a re-entrant call would panic.
fix: Copy the badge count out first, then add other accounts

title: window_title_shown borrow()/borrow_mut() in non-test code
trigger: sync_window_title each frame
effect: Short scopes, no re-entrancy today; rule 6 still records them.
fix: Cell/RefCell with try_borrow or plain field on QuillApp

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on the cached X11 connection
trigger: Any X11 call that re-enters connection() while forget_connection runs (not reachable today)
effect: A reentrant call would panic with already borrowed; both sites are short but unguarded, unlike forget_connection which uses try_borrow_mut. CONNECTION.with(|slot| slot.borrow().clone()) at 295 and slot.borrow_mut() at 305
fix: Use try_borrow / try_borrow_mut and treat a failure as no cached connection

title: Closing the AI box leaves the language search text; it reappears when the box is reopened
trigger: Open box, Translate tab, tap the language, type a query, Cancel and close the box, open it again and open the language picker
effect: The picker opens filtered by the old query
fix: Clear language_search in close_ai_compose / open_ai_compose (or hold the query in AiComposeView::Languages)

title: ai_compose_dispatch returns without failing the box when there is no live connection, so the box stays Loading
trigger: Open the box (or change tab) while self.live is None (demo session, connection being replaced)
effect: Skeleton and spinner stay until the box is closed; the request token is never answered nor failed
fix: Treat live None like a send error: ai.fail(token, ..) and toast

title: remove_ai_style closes the editor and returns to the card when nothing was sent (no live)
trigger: Edit Style, Delete Style, confirm, while live is None
effect: Editor closes with no toast, the style is not deleted
fix: Only close the editor on Some(Ok(request)); toast on None

title: open_ai_style_preview treats 'no live connection' as sent, so the preview stays LookingUp forever
trigger: Open an addstyle link while self.live is None
effect: Loading skeleton with no request out; only closing the box ends it
fix: is_none_or should be a send failure unless demo_session is the owner

title: Story cover and privacy answers settle by request but act on the panel and story open now, not the ones that sent
trigger: Save a story cover (or privacy), open the Cover picker on another story or reopen it before the answer; Saved closes whichever Cover panel is open; Failed reports against open_cover_story()
effect: A fresh picker closes under the user, or the failure names the wrong story
fix: Hold the story key with the request (cover_request: Option<(RequestId, StoryKey)>) and close or report only when the panel is for that key

title: Main render runs file-fetching steps before the lock check, so a Premium preview left open keeps downloading while locked
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview, lock the app; sync_premium_preview_files (and inline_videos_frame_start, check_video_pip, sync_video_avatar, sync_userpic_videos) still run each frame before is_locked() returns locked_root
effect: Downloads and video work while locked; contradicts 'what runs while locked' (only notifications)
fix: Move the steps under a lock_waits() guard or after the locked early return

title: Toast wake-up is a detached spawn_screen task named by ToastQueue::wake; skipped after an account switch, so the toast outlives its deadline until something else redraws
trigger: Account A posts a toast (wake armed for deadline D, task detached). Switch to account B before D. At D the task's update is not run (spawn_screen: no updates once another account is on screen), so no notify happens; ToastQueue (app part of ConnectionUi) is shown on B and nothing redraws an idle B.
effect: The toast stays on screen past its time until the next unrelated redraw; ToastQueue::wake keeps naming a timer that never delivered
fix: hold the timer Task inside the queue's stage (Armed { deadline, task }) and spawn it as an app task (spawn_app), so it notifies whichever account is on screen and is dropped with the queue

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut of frame.surfaces.toasts in the render path
trigger: status_toast_in runs per window frame; any future call from inside the borrow (follow/moving are pure today) or a re-entrant frame would panic. chat_window close uses try_borrow_mut for the same cell, so the two paths already assume overlap.
effect: Panic on the UI thread if the borrow ever overlaps
fix: try_borrow_mut with an early return (panic-safety rule 6) or a plain per-window slot owned by the WindowSlot
